answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 200 credits to join; the bond loses 10 per epoch unless work replenishes it. A gale of registrations cannot linger for free: 1,000 fakes cost 200,000 plus 10,000 per epoch, above rewards they split. This breaks the fable of free scale: idle copies bleed value, while one honest agent pays once, renews through work, and keeps undiluted rewards as a zephyr of newcomers passes the check.
